title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: PagerDuty
providers.scope_notes: SaaS; REST API on current plans, user token keys need Advanced Permissions, Audit Trail on Business/Enterprise for Incident Management/Digital Operations (legacy); SCIM uses general access keys or app OAuth tokens.

controls.name: Revoke All Tokens (App Registration)
controls.what: App owner invalidates all OAuth tokens issued to the app.
controls.setting: Integrations > Developer Tools > App Registration > app > OAuth Client > Revoke All Tokens

controls.name: Scoped OAuth scopes
controls.what: Per-resource read/write scopes (e.g. incidents.read) limit what the token can call.

controls.name: App Registration role requirement
controls.what: Only Manager, Global Admin, or Account Owner base roles can register apps, so lower roles cannot create private OAuth apps.

no_control.what: No IP/network restriction for OAuth app tokens.

controls_unknown: Whether general access or user token keys can be given an expiry, or ever expire.
Whether SSO enforcement or deprovisioning in the IdP affects existing API keys (only "user leaves the account" disables user keys).
Any admin setting to block users from creating user token keys or to block Classic User OAuth app authorization.
Whether API key create/disable/delete events appear in the Audit Trail (the tracked resource list does not include API keys).
Whether disabling/deleting a key or Revoke All User Tokens ends in-flight access immediately (Revoke All runs in the background).
Whether private app (client credentials) tokens can be revoked by admins other than the app owner; client secret expiry/rotation.
Whether read (GET) API calls are logged anywhere customer-visible.
Whether integration key creation/rotation appears in audit records (support page says integration add/remove is not captured; Audit API lists Integrations as an associated resource of Services).

auth_paths.name: Scoped OAuth app token (private app, client credentials)

authentication.summary: A private app with Scoped OAuth exchanges client_id/client_secret at https://identity.pagerduty.com/oauth/token (client_credentials) for a Bearer token limited only by the app's scopes, not by any user.

federation.details: No workload identity federation documented; client secret only.

ip_restriction.boundary: IP allow list does not restrict REST API calls.

lifetime.summary: Access token 1 day; client secret no documented expiry

renewal.summary: App requests a new token with its client secret; no refresh token.

administration.summary: Manager, Global Admin or Account Owner can register apps under Integrations > Developer Tools > App Registration. Private apps need no install review and are not in the OAuth Apps list (Manage Private Apps instead).
administration.conditions: App tokens are only issued on the account that created the app.

offboard.details: Client-credentials app tokens have no user involved.

inventory.details: Private apps are listed under OAuth Apps > Manage Private Apps (and App Registration > My Apps); issued app tokens are not listed.

expiry.api: Fixed 1-day lifetime; POST https://identity.pagerduty.com/oauth/token response field expires_in

token_format.notes: Documented example access token is "pdus+_EXAMPLE_KEY_ID_EXAMPLE_TOKEN"; prefix not formally specified.

log_sources.name: Audit Trail (UI + GET /audit/records)
log_sources.notes: Business, Enterprise for Incident Management, Digital Operations (legacy); 12-month retention; config changes on users, teams, schedules, escalation policies, services, IP allow lists only. Admin / global API token, scope audit_records.read.

anomaly_cues: app_reference actors you do not recognize
Private apps created by Managers without review

containment.steps: App Registration > app > OAuth Client > Revoke All Tokens, then delete and recreate OAuth functionality to replace the client secret (revoke first: deleting does not revoke tokens).
containment.notes: Docs say Revoke All Tokens invalidates all tokens; app tokens otherwise expire in 1 day.

calls.log_notes: Audit records cover configuration changes only.

unknown: Whether GET /users/me works with an app token.
